experimental_design: characterization of the LAMP fraction from TX-114 phase partitioning

we utilized TX-114 phase partitioning to fractionate Mp proteins into three fractions: a LAMP hydrophobic detergent phase, an aqueous phase (Aq) harboring mostly hydrophilic cytosolic proteins, and an insoluble phase (Ins)
factor_value: Proteomic analysis to reveal lipoproteins, elongation factors, chaperones and chaperonins, and cytadherence proteins (previously found to induce strong antibody responses) as the most abundant immunogenic and antigenic components of the LAMP fraction
number_of_fractions: fractionate Mp proteins into three fractions
